core_obligations: Choose an affine open of the base and an affine open of the middle scheme over it (proof lines 8941-8946).
Restrict ampleness from the composite preimage to the smaller affine open and verify the quasi-compactness hypothesis (proof lines 8946-8953).
Conclude with the affine-open criterion for relative ampleness (proof lines 8954-8958).
proof_roadmap: Affine opens in the base and the middle scheme (proof lines 8941-8946).
Restriction of ampleness to the smaller affine (proof lines 8946-8954).
Relative ampleness by the affine-open criterion (proof lines 8954-8958).
difficulty_reason: The lemma states that if a morphism is quasi-compact and an invertible sheaf is ample for the composite of that morphism with a further morphism, then the sheaf is ample for the first morphism alone. The proof chooses an affine open in the base and an affine open of the middle scheme mapping into it, observes that the restriction of the sheaf to the preimage of the base affine is ample by hypothesis, and that the preimage of the middle affine sits inside it as a quasi-compact open immersion, so that the restriction is ample there too; the characterisation of relative ampleness by affine opens in the base then gives the conclusion.
